description: This file contains the implementation of a Orleans grain class 'StatelessWorkerScalingGrain' that manages scaling and activation counts for stateless workers, along with a shared state class. It includes methods for synchronization and retrieval of activation/waiting counts as well as internal state management.

classes.name: StatelessWorkerScalingGrainSharedState
classes.description: Holds shared state for the scaling grain, including a semaphore for synchronization and dictionaries tracking activation and waiting counts per grain ID.

classes.name: StatelessWorkerScalingGrain
classes.description: A stateless worker grain with a maximum local worker limit, managing activation counts and synchronization via shared state.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Increments waiting count, waits asynchronously on the semaphore, then decrements waiting count.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Releases the semaphore, allowing waiting grains to proceed.

methods.name: GetActivationCount
methods.description: Returns the current activation count for this grain.

methods.name: GetWaitingCount
methods.description: Returns the current waiting count for this grain.
